2608.30661.title: SwarmBench: Can Large Language Models Act as Agent Swarm Orchestrators?
2608.30661.paper_summary: Large language model-based multi-agent systems are evolving from fixed interaction topologies toward dynamically orchestrated Agent Swarms. However, existing benchmarks are still largely based on single-agent or general-purpose agent tasks, making it difficult to systematically evaluate key orchestration capabilities. We propose SwarmBench, a benchmark that evaluates model performance from multiple perspectives, including accuracy, efficiency, cost, and process quality. Experimental results show that current models exhibit substantial differences in orchestration capability. These differences are reflected not only in final accuracy, efficiency, and cost, but also in the overall quality of the orchestration process itself. Based on these findings, we further propose SwarmExp, a simple yet effective method based on experience extraction and experience replay, which consistently improves the orchestration performance of large language models.
2608.30661.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型基礎的多代理系統正在從固定的互動拓撲演變為動態編排的代理群體。<lb/>然而，現有的基準仍然主要基於單一代理或通用代理任務，使得系統性評估關鍵的編排能力變得困難。<lb/>我們提出了SwarmBench，一個從多個角度評估模型性能的基準，包括準確性、效率、成本和過程質量。<lb/>實驗結果顯示，當前模型在編排能力上存在顯著差異。<lb/>這些差異不僅體現在最終的準確性、效率和成本上，還體現在編排過程本身的整體質量上。<lb/>基於這些發現，我們進一步提出了SwarmExp，一種基於經驗提取和經驗重播的簡單而有效的方法，該方法持續改善大型語言模型的編排性能。
